items.title: Building in public
items.text: The practice of sharing your work with openness and transparency.

items.title: Show Your Work!
items.text: A book by Austin Kleon about building in public.

items.title: So create
items.quote: When you don't create things, you become defined by your tastes rather than ability. Your tastes only narrow and exclude people. So create.

items.title: The Gap
items.quote:
All of us who do creative work, we get into it because we have good taste. But there is this gap.
For the first couple years you make stuff, it’s just not that good. It’s trying to be good, it has potential, but it’s not. But your taste, the thing that got you into the game, is still killer. And your taste is why your work disappoints you.
